locations.name: A shrine garden off the main street

collaborator.gift: a mixtape labeled only 'city sounds, vol. 4'

preShowChoices.label: Play it tight and precise
preShowChoices.description: Every hit exactly where it should be.

preShowChoices.label: Let it breathe and improvise
preShowChoices.description: Loosen the click track. See what happens.

preShowChoices.label: Build the whole set around Rowan's bassline
preShowChoices.description: Hand the room over to the one who's earned it.

minigames.title: Pack the Van
minigames.introText: Load-out's fast here — everything back in the van before the next act's gear shows up.
minigames.outroText: Everything's stowed with room to spare. Theo actually looks relaxed.
minigames.outroTextRough: Half-packed and out of time — you finish the rest on the sidewalk, laughing about it.

tok_arrival.speaker: narrator
tok_arrival.text: Tokyo hits like static — signs stacked on signs, a hundred conversations you don't understand and don't need to.

choices.label: Walk it off before soundcheck
Find the hotel and actually rest
Check on Rowan, who's gone quiet

tok_arrival_walk.speaker: narrator
tok_arrival_walk.text: Every block sounds like a different song. You steal a rhythm from a crosswalk chime.

tok_arrival_rest.speaker: narrator
tok_arrival_rest.text: The room is the size of the bus bunk, and somehow that's a comfort.

tok_arrival_rowan.speaker: rowan
tok_arrival_rowan.text: "I'm fine," Rowan says, in the tone that means the opposite.

tok_loc_arcade.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade.text: Rhythm cabinets flash in perfect sync. A local rests a challenge coin on the machine, grinning.

choices.label: Accept the challenge
Just watch the pros play

tok_loc_arcade_win.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade_win.text: You lose badly and learn something about timing anyway.

tok_loc_arcade_watch.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade_watch.text: Their hands move faster than the notes should allow.

tok_loc_ramen.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen.text: Steam fogs the window. The owner slides four bowls across without being asked twice.

choices.label: Toast to the tour, loudly
Eat in comfortable silence

tok_loc_ramen_toast.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen_toast.text: The owner laughs and refuses to let you pay full price.

tok_loc_ramen_quiet.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen_quiet.text: Nobody needs to fill the air. That's its own kind of closeness.

tok_loc_shrine.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine.text: Gravel crunches underfoot. The city noise drops to almost nothing here, like a held breath.

choices.label: Follow the ritual, unsure but sincere
Just sit with the quiet

tok_loc_shrine_ritual.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine_ritual.text: You don't know if you did it right. It felt right anyway.

tok_loc_shrine_sit.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine_sit.text: For once, nobody's phone buzzes. Nobody checks.

tok_loc_karaoke.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_karaoke.text: A tiny room, a too-big screen, and a song list none of you can read.

choices.label: Pick something at random and commit
Let Jun DJ the whole session

tok_loc_karaoke_sing.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_karaoke_sing.text: It's terrible. It's perfect. Nobody films it, which somehow makes it better.

tok_loc_karaoke_dj.speaker: jun
tok_loc_karaoke_dj.text: Jun's setlist makes no sense and works completely.

tok_loc_pachinko.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko.text: A wall of chrome balls and chiming lights, and one grandmother playing three machines at once like she owns the building.

choices.label: Feed a machine a few coins
Just watch the grandmother work

tok_loc_pachinko_try.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko_try.text: You lose every coin in under a minute and somehow leave grinning.

tok_loc_pachinko_watch.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko_watch.text: She never once looks at the balls. Forty years of muscle memory, still ringing.

tok_rel_rowan.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan.text: "Nobody requests the bass solo," Rowan says. "I've counted."

choices.label: Promise tonight's different
Just listen, don't fix it

tok_rel_rowan_a.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_a.text: Rowan doesn't quite smile, but the bass case opens a little more eagerly.

tok_rel_rowan_b.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_b.text: "Thanks for not saying it'll be fine," Rowan says.

tok_rel_mira.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira.text: "My voice cracked in Lisbon and everyone clapped louder," Mira says. "I don't get it."

choices.label: That crack was the realest thing all night
Maybe stop counting the cracks

tok_rel_mira_a.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira_a.text: "Huh," Mira says, like the idea is new and heavy and good.

tok_rel_mira_b.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira_b.text: She laughs, short and surprised. Progress, maybe.

tok_rel_jun.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun.text: "Found a pedal at a shop that does something I can't explain," Jun says. "Can we afford it?"

choices.label: Buy it. Figure out the budget later
Not this tour

tok_rel_jun_a.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_a.text: Jun is already rewiring the pedalboard by soundcheck.

tok_rel_jun_b.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_b.text: Jun writes the model number down anyway. For later.

tok_rel_theo.speaker: theo
tok_rel_theo.text: "I found one quiet room in this whole city," Theo says. "It was the stairwell. I sat in the stairwell for an hour."

choices.label: Find a stairwell of my own, sit with you
We're cutting something from the set tonight. Your call.

tok_rel_theo_a.speaker: theo
tok_rel_theo_a.text: Neither of you says much. The stairwell holds long enough.

tok_rel_theo_b.speaker: theo
tok_rel_theo_b.text: Theo picks the bridge nobody would miss. First real decision he's made all week.

tok_rel_mira2.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira2.text: "They want an encore every night now," Mira says. "I don't know how many more I have in me."

choices.label: Then give them less. They'll still show up.
One more push. I'll help you find it.

tok_rel_mira2_a.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira2_a.text: "Less," Mira repeats, like she's allowed to. Her shoulders actually drop.

tok_rel_mira2_b.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira2_b.text: She finds it. Voice cracking on purpose this time — the room loves it more.

tok_preshow.speaker: narrator
tok_preshow.text: The venue's LEDs sync to your soundcheck without being asked. Tokyo is already listening.

tok_aftershow.speaker: narrator
tok_aftershow.text: The crowd files out into neon and rain, already talking about tonight.

choices.label: Say yes to the afterparty
Wind down quietly with the band

tok_aftershow_a.speaker: narrator
tok_aftershow_a.text: You don't remember half the conversations. You remember feeling wanted.

tok_aftershow_b.speaker: narrator
tok_aftershow_b.text: Four people, one van, the city's hum fading outside the windows.

tok_journal.speaker: narrator
tok_journal.text: You write: Tokyo never once slowed down for us. We kept up anyway.
